candidates.scope: Audit/diagnosis and harness-improvement settings; these results do not by themselves prove higher end-task success in arbitrary agents.
Strongest positive evidence is formal/math reasoning with executable verifiers; negative control concerns intrinsic prompting, not verifier-guided or trained-critic correction.
Evidence spans weight-frozen NL state, harness evolution, and bounded post-training; repeated reuse of a fixed dev set may itself overfit and remains an explicit unresolved frontier.
Model×scaffold×domain interactions are large; no blanket rejection of memory/skills is supported. Public third-party adapter/config for the cited EvoAgentBench cell is missing.

members: A4#On Training LLMs for Long-Horizon Tasks
candidates.scope: Evidence spans embodied tasks, synthetic planning/training, and formal verification; some comparisons are not compute-matched and the Context-Folding quantitative claim is lower-confidence in this clean run.
Environment-dependent long-horizon studies; UltraHorizon's CRNR reset mechanism is mechanistically supported but a trustworthy numeric delta was not extracted.
Theorem strongest in linear tasks; vision replay studies often use frozen/pre-extracted features; LLM replay-rate/model-time numbers still need primary-table extraction.
candidates.boundary: More replay can worsen forgetting; therefore replay quantity is explicitly non-monotonic and any positive replay result is conditional on selection/scheduling/representation.

candidates.scope: Tasks share state space/dynamics and differ in reward; planner is given reward functions. Not evidence for arbitrary nonstationary dynamics or open-ended task discovery.

AFTER is a preprint and repo does not expose all experiment outputs; KSI exact project-page cells still need primary-table cross-check; CORAL's shared memory may conflict with strict independent-exploration settings.
Negative debate evidence is one homogeneous-model GSM8K setup and does not reject heterogeneous/specialized MAS; positive routing evidence is limited to tested architectures/benchmarks.
Evaluator-rich algorithmic/configuration settings; exact niche ratio and archive sizes are not universal, and shared-memory mechanisms are not automatically appropriate for independent workers.
ML research tasks with executable experiments; per-model matched scaffold ablations are still needed to isolate scaffold effect from backend/budget.
ASI-Bench diagnoses a planning bottleneck rather than proving a specific planner; P^3 uses frontier models and one run per task/model/method configuration.
Intervention verifier architecture itself is not yet cleanly ablated in an online research loop; benchmark-audit evidence is from a small number of benchmark families.
Contamination rates depend on benchmark and retrieval infrastructure; premise gating must not suppress legitimate contrarian/high-risk hypothesis exploration without evidence.
Demonstrated in training/evaluation data creation, not end-to-end scientific method selection or manuscript integrity.
Benchmark establishes a severe literature-discovery bottleneck but does not yet identify a high-performing solution mechanism.
Positive Elo is self-evaluated rather than independent ground truth; debate failure is one homogeneous arithmetic setup. Mechanism remains conditional and requires matched-budget independent tests.
Most evidence is NLG/scientific QA rather than full agent traces; mitigation cost-effectiveness and transfer to tool-use decisions remain open.
RewardBench 2's PPO predictive validity is much more configuration-sensitive than Best-of-N; dynamic objective scoring is hard for open-ended agents without ground truth.
Math-specific and expensive human intermediate labeling; transfer to general tool-using agents is not established.
Lean theorem proving; benefit appears conditional on RL-induced mode narrowing and can harm SFT policies.
Supervised image/time-series tasks rather than autonomous continual agents; independent replication not found; DLL sequential character prediction substantially lags backprop.
Canonical XdG assumes task/context identity is supplied; exact headline accuracies were not extracted in this clean run.
Marginal slow-loop ablations and matched compute/cost remain pending primary-table verification; current evidence is medium.
MAX-MIN Ant System configuration on generated TSP-like instances; exact efficiency ratio does not transfer automatically to research loops.
SAT solver selection with engineered features/hardness models; requires out-of-sample routing validation and includes feature-computation overhead.
Fully strict multithreaded computations; very short tasks incur spawn/communication overhead. For clean research, stolen units must remain O-blind to preserve independence.
Photostability/materials chemistry; 1.5% is search-space coverage, not a universal speedup factor.
Software fault localization with reproducible perturbation/replay; a single dramatic case is not an average-case speedup estimate.
